newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee, cocoa end up after despite NY falls.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee, cocoa end up after despite NY falls.

text.p: COFFEE - Swings in either direction to end narrowly mixed. July up $10 at $1,660 after a $43 range. NY loses ground after Thursday's rally.
COCOA - Despite NY falls, edges higher in slow business ahead of UK trade dinner. July up six at 994 stg, well above 980 support.
SUGAR - Tightly mixed in modest trade before long three-day weekend due to bank holiday on Monday. Aug off 20 cents at $310.50 at 1601 GMT.
